originalTitle: RL in 10,000 LoC with Joseph Suarez
title: Cutting PufferLib to 10,000 Lines and Merging Environment PRs
summary: Refactored PufferLib to under 10,000 lines by compressing an LLM-generated C environment and auditing core files. Merged contributor environments including a large Runescape port and a Tower Defense env, with code review and performance discussion.
